title: On Boston's Unramified Conjecture for $\GL_2$ and McLeman's $(3,3)$-Conjecture
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime number. Based on recent work of Zhang, we prove that for a finite set $S$ of primes of $\Q$ containing $\infty$ but not $p$, any continuous odd representation $G_{\Q,S} \to \GL_2(A)$ over a complete Noetherian local ring $A$ with finite residue field of characteristic $p$ has finite image, where $G_{\Q,S}$ denotes the Galois group of the maximal extension of $\Q$ unramified outside $S$.
